main_text.p: quæ jam ante in curiâ Romanâ satis disceptata ac refutata essent: si serio pacem & quietem cuperent Carthaginienses, nil opus habere, quæ ad bellum gerendum facerent: quapropter arma omnia publica & privata, catapultas, & quicquid ejus generis, Romanis traderent: si quis hostis ipsos esset lacessiturus, aut vi preslurus[?], id Romanis curæ futurum. Quid facerent tanto periculo, tantâ vi circumventi? Parituros se etiam in hoc responderunt, ut lege tam durâ pacem redimerent. Traditaque sunt sine morâ ducenta armaturarum millia, duo millia catapultarum diversi generis, telorum & jacu-rum numerus infinitus; atque hæc[illegible, ~2 letters] omnia inspecta à duobus Scipionibus[illegible, ~2 letters] hanc ob causam in urbem missis, longo ordine in castra consulum devecta admirantibus Romanis, & pone secuti legati cum primoribus civitatis & sacerdotibus, ut præsentia suâ consulum animos moverent. Tum verò rursum Consul Marcius, Laudamus, inquit, Carthaginienses, promptitudinem in his vestram: sed ne moremur vos diu, aperienda sunt reliqua senatus nostri mandata, eaque fortiter à vobis ferenda, quoniam urget necessitas. Cedite nobis urbe vestrâ, & sedes, quò libet,

page.notes: The right margin carries small, faint marks (letters or signs, perhaps reference marks) beside the lines "atque hæc", "Scipionibus" and "jacu-rum"; they are not legible, so they are marked as illegible. "preslurus" is uncertain: the long s and the following letters are hard to separate at this resolution. The line "hac" below the text is treated as a catchword. The faint letters at the bottom right edge and the show-through from the other side are left out.
